anti_rescue_rule: After the first external scoring run, no dataset substitution, assay-set edit, threshold change, identity rule change, missingness rule change, model parameter change, comparator change, budget change, data-sufficiency threshold change, or success criterion change is permitted in this experiment.

bootstrap.quantity: mean paired cost difference target minus strongest comparator over liability-positive candidates

claim: With critical evidence still unknown, the frozen continuous-value conditional-risk selector can reduce assay spend to first declared developability liability on an independent antibody panel without increasing false reassurance at the frozen three-assay budget relative to the strongest admissible comparator.
information_gain_baseline: For each unmeasured assay, use the same frozen logistic risk estimator as the target, then choose the assay with maximum Bernoulli entropy H(p); this is an uncertainty/information-gain comparator, not a promotion rule.

model_form.constant_label_rule: Use the constant training label as probability when an assay target has one class.
model_form.features: only already observed assay values for that held-out candidate
model_form.no_observation_rule: Use leave-one-out training prevalence for remaining assays.

positive_verdict_rule: Data sufficient AND target mean assay cost strictly lower than strongest comparator AND paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound for target-minus-comparator mean cost is < 0 AND target false reassurance at budget 3 is <= strongest comparator.
prediction_boundary: The selector estimates assay-liability risk only to allocate the next measurement. It does not predict therapeutic efficacy, clinical success, or authorize promotion.
relationship_to_prior_work: External confirmation of the frozen Jain sequential assay selector; not Candidate Promotion Gate and not a new selection framework.
strongest_comparator_rule: Among admissible comparators choose the lowest mean assays to first liability on liability-positive candidates; tie by lower false reassurance at budget 3; final tie by strategy name.
